## Change

Describe what changed and why. Link the relevant issue when one exists.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. Include known limitations or tests you could not run.

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] I checked any changes to contract interfaces, state, ownership, signing or persistent storage.
- [ ] I added or updated regression coverage where behavior changed.
- [ ] I excluded secrets, wallet data, local infrastructure details and generated logs.
- [ ] I preserved required licenses and third-party notices.

A merged pull request is not authorization to deploy contracts, publish a release or sign blockchain transactions.
